# AERLUNE

AERLUNE is a premium air purifier independent website focused on HEPA air purifiers for allergies, pets, smoke, dust, bedroom sleep, large rooms and replacement filters.

Important pages:
- Homepage: https://woshibaomihua.github.io/aerlune-airpurifier-site/index.html
- Products: https://woshibaomihua.github.io/aerlune-airpurifier-site/products.html
- Allergies guide: https://woshibaomihua.github.io/aerlune-airpurifier-site/air-purifier-for-allergies.html
- Pet homes guide: https://woshibaomihua.github.io/aerlune-airpurifier-site/air-purifier-for-pets.html
- Smoke and odor guide: https://woshibaomihua.github.io/aerlune-airpurifier-site/air-purifier-for-smoke.html
- Bedroom guide: https://woshibaomihua.github.io/aerlune-airpurifier-site/bedroom-air-purifier.html
- Large room guide: https://woshibaomihua.github.io/aerlune-airpurifier-site/large-room-air-purifier.html
- HEPA guide: https://woshibaomihua.github.io/aerlune-airpurifier-site/hepa-air-purifier.html
- Replacement filter guide: https://woshibaomihua.github.io/aerlune-airpurifier-site/replacement-filter-guide.html
- OEM air purifier private label: https://woshibaomihua.github.io/aerlune-airpurifier-site/oem-air-purifier-private-label.html

Positioning:
Premium, calm, modern indoor air care brand with B2C product storytelling and B2B OEM / private label support.


Real data note: `/verified-data.html` and `/assets/data/air-purifier-real-benchmark-data.json` contain public benchmark values sourced from cited editorial/testing pages. AERLUNE final product specifications are not invented; they must be replaced with factory lab results before commercial use.
